title: Tesla receives approval for self-driving tech in Slovakia
source_used: Reuters wire text on Global Banking & Finance Review; Not a Tesla App for detail (Reuters page returned 401)
key_facts: Slovakia approved Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, the company said in a post on X on Friday 16 Oct 2026 (Reuters).
Tesla Europe said the supervised software has been approved and will start rolling out in Slovakia soon.
Not a Tesla App counts Slovakia as the ninth European country to approve the software, after neighbor Czechia in September and Croatia later that month.
The system remains supervised driver assistance: drivers must stay alert and in control.
Tesla renamed FSD (Supervised) to "Tesla Assisted Driving" in Europe as part of its push for EU-wide approval.
Not a Tesla App says an EU-wide vote was delayed to December and needs at least 15 countries in favor; France and Sweden oppose, mainly over a feature that can exceed posted speed limits.
quote_evidence: Oct 16 (Reuters) - Slovakia approved Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, the company said in a post on X on Friday.
Slovakia has become the ninth European country to approve Tesla Assisted Driving, the new name for FSD (Supervised), ahead of December’s EU-wide vote.
Tesla renamed FSD (Supervised) to Tesla Assisted Driving across the continent as part of its push for EU-wide approval.
why_it_matters_hint: Another European country allows Tesla's supervised driving software, adding to Tesla's case for an EU-wide approval vote in December.
notes: Reuters page (401) not opened; Reuters wire text read on Global Banking & Finance Review, detail from Not a Tesla App (a Tesla-focused news site). The approval is announced by Tesla; a Slovak transport ministry page is linked in the Reuters copy but was not opened.
